$Comment: What a member of a boss fight sees when the fight moves into its next phase: the script
signalled a phase beat, and whatever it changes (a role swap, a wave of adds, a new stance) is
This is the library's own neutral default; a mod's same-named file or the owner layer
replaces it, and the binding row's Feedback.PhaseChanged leaf can point a fight elsewhere.
The moment fires once per live member and carries 'encounter' (the script id), 'title' (the
fight's name in the reader's language), 'phase' (the script's own state name for the phase,
exactly as signalled, so a script that names its states readably reads well here), 'members',
'seconds', 'participants' and 'source'. 'player' is the member it is about.
A quiet personal notice by default, in the plain Info tone: a phase is a beat inside a fight,
not a payout. Add a Sound to give it a sting, or a Broadcast to tell the arena.
